subject: Intro demo → engineering deep dive: propose prework + revised timing
messages:
From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratify.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-19T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Intro demo next week — availability

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the intro — we're excited to see Redwood. We'd like a quick 45-minute demo next week to understand the hosted API and how it could replace some of our current inference hooks.

Availability: Tue/Wed afternoons PST preferred. Attendees: myself, Alex (product), two engineers (short).

Two quick asks: if possible, could we make it slightly technical (a little more on integration points) so the engineers can judge effort? Also, Alex will be traveling the week of Apr 7 — want to avoid scheduling into his travel if it helps.

Best,
Jordan
Product Manager — Stratify.ai
[External]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — availability

Hey Jordan — thanks for the note and the heads-up on Alex's travel. Quick thought: given your ask for integration detail and engineers joining, would you be open to converting the 45-minute intro into a 90-minute engineering deep dive / scoping session? That lets us go through API patterns, deployment variants (hosted vs dedicated), and a short mutual-action checklist so your engineers can estimate effort.

A few details / asks from our side:
- Prework: 10–15 minutes for the team to fill in a short environment & constraints doc (link below) so we can tailor the deep dive.
- Attendees: Please include the engineer who owns model-serving decisions (or their proxy). Vivek (cc'd) would lead from our infra side.
- Format: 60 minutes demo + 30 minutes breakout Q&A/POC scoping. We can split into two 60-min blocks if timezones/travel require it.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 3/26 1:00–2:30pm
- Thu 3/27 10:00–11:30am
- Tue 4/1 3:00–4:30pm

If Alex is traveling week of 4/7, the 3/26–4/1 window should avoid that. I attached a quick agenda & a blank MAP template we can populate together. If those slots don't work, propose 2 alternate times and we can adapt (we can also split sessions).

Links: https://redwood.app/s/demo-prework-stratify (prework)
Attachment: Redwood-engineering-deep-dive-agenda.pdf

Thanks — happy to be flexible here.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-engineering-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratify.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@stratify.ai>
Date: 2025-03-20T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — availability

Thanks, Irene — this sounds great and actually preferable. A deeper session with prework will help our engineers. A couple notes from our side:

- Alex confirms travel the week of Apr 7, so your proposed 3/26 or 3/27 slots are better.
- Our engineers prefer splitting a heavy session into two 60-min blocks (first for integration overview + API walk, second for hands-on scoping). Could you accommodate split sessions?
- We need a recording because one engineer will be remote and cannot make one of the slots.

Proposed from us:
- Split option A: Wed 3/26 1:00–2:00pm (overview + API) and Thu 3/27 10:00–11:00am (scoping + Q&A) — both PST.
- Split option B: Tue 4/1 3:00–4:00pm + Thu 4/3 3:00–4:00pm if you prefer the later week.

Also can you drop a populated MAP with our prework answers before the session? I'll have Alex and our engineering lead fill the prework doc by EOD Monday so you can tune the session.

Jordan
Product Manager — Stratify.ai
[On travel: "Alex will be out Apr 7–11"]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@stratify.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-03-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week — availability

Jordan — great, thanks for the options. We can do the split sessions; I will send two calendar invites and share a brief populated MAP based on the notes you've provided. We'll also record the second session.

Final plan (tentative):
- Session 1: Wed 2025-03-26 13:00–14:00 PST — Integration overview + API walkthrough (Irene + Vivek)
- Session 2: Thu 2025-03-27 10:00–11:00 PST — Scoping + Q&A (Irene + Vivek) — recorded

Attachments included: Stratify-MAP-template.xlsx (pre-filled with the environment bits Jordan shared)
Calendar invites will follow from my assistant; please confirm attendees so we don't miss anyone. If Alex becomes available, we can merge or forward the recording.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Stratify-MAP-template.xlsx (XLSX)]
